notes: nor belongs to the waw: the Hebrew gaps the negative in the second member and the ASV writes one word carrying both the coordination and the negation there, which rule 35 assigns to the waw and rule 25's closing sentence confirms against the distributed-negative reading.

to the right hand and to the left are adverbial accusatives whose supplied prepositions and determiners belong to the nouns themselves (rules 33, 15); hand is the generic completing right, which carries the lexeme (rule 31).
